offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures blood management devices and disposable kits for plasma and blood collection centers and hospitals. Sold directly and through distributors, with equipment placed under recurring disposables and service.

primary_products.value: plasma collection systems; whole blood processing systems; surgical blood salvage devices; hemostasis testing systems; disposable blood processing kits

primary_services.value: equipment service and maintenance; customer training

customer_segment.value: B2B: plasma collection centers, blood centers, hospitals and surgical providers

revenue_model.value: product sales: blood processing equipment and single-use disposable kits sold to blood centers and hospitals; service fees: equipment service contracts and maintenance

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds devices and disposables from purchased components, sold to blood centers and hospitals; service provider: maintains installed equipment for blood collection and hospital customers

geography_served.value: global: Sells worldwide with major markets in North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: plasma, whole blood and surgical blood management lines sharing blood center and hospital customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to blood centers, plasma collectors and hospitals; distributors / dealers: independent distributors in some international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices needing FDA clearance and EU medical device approval, plus blood establishment rules
